dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Distinct concave indentation located on the left lateral margin approximately mid-way down the visible body length.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white skin tone across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single small, dark localized point of contrast on the right side of the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Significant circular topological depression casting internal shadows, located on the left side of the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, pronounced circular pit on the left flank indicating significant localized physical trauma or structural anomaly.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct, linear central dorsal ridge extending longitudinally across the length of the visible surface.
